brief_title: A Personal Nutrition Advisor to Assist Remote Dietary Counselling for Weight Loss and Maintenance
official_title: A Personal Nutrition Advisor to Assist Remote Dietary Counselling for Weight Loss and Maintenance

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in the overall mean satisfaction score of the Nutritional and Dietetic Patient Outcomes Questionnaire (NDPOQ)
primary_outcomes.time_frame: From baseline to 3 months of the respective study period

primary_outcomes.measure: The overall mean score of the "perceived impact" section from the user version of the mobile application scale (uMARS )
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Post intervention visit (3 months after baseline)

primary_outcomes.measure: The overall mean score of the Healthcare Systems Usability Scale (HSUS)
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Post intervention visit (3 months after baseline)

brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to assess the usability of the PNA and satisfaction with the treatment within the framework of usual care remote nutritional counselling for GLP-1-supported weight management and collect pilot data on its potential to support weight loss.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Written informed consent
* Receiving GLP-1-based pharmacotherapy in combination with remote nutritional counselling
* Achieved weight loss of ≥5 (for baseline BMI 28-35 kg/m2) or ≥7% (for baseline BMI≥35kg/m2) after 4 months of GLP-1 based therapy (1st milestone)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to give written informed consent
* Any physical or psychological disease or condition likely to interfere with the normal conduct of the study and interpretation of the study results
* Self-reported pregnancy, planed pregnancy within next 3 months or breast-feeding
* Concomitant participation in another trial that interferes with the normal conduct of the study and interpretation of the study results
* Not proficient in German

sites.facility: Department of Diabetes, Endocrinology, Clinical Nutrition and Metabolism, Inselspital, Bern University Hospital
